SAGES_TEMPLATE_V1: managed by pi-orchestrator/scripts/install.sh. pi-subagents reads toolDescriptionMode and looks up {{agentDir}}/agent-tool-description.md (installed by install.sh from pi-orchestrator/templates/agent-tool-description.md). Project-level .pi/subagents.json overrides this global; leave existing user keys intact — merge, don't replace. _sages_template_marker is a hidden key checked by uninstall_subagents_config to detect 'our install'.

GC-2026-subagent-model-inheritance: subagents now inherit the parent session's model by default (the previous `AgentConfig.model` hardcoded pins are gone — Developer/Reviewer/Explore/PlanCompiler all fall through to the parent's model). `defaultModelsByType` is now the *override* path: users who want a stronger reasoning model for code work can pin Developer/Reviewer there. Without an entry in this map, the subagent uses whatever model the main agent is using.

Resolution chain (highest to lowest):
  1. `Agent({ model })` caller-supplied override (rare; usually interactive override)
  2. `subagents.json#defaultModelsByType[<type>]` — explicit per-type pin (this file)
  3. Parent session model — default (GC-2026-subagent-model-inheritance makes this the new floor)
  4. `settings.json#defaultProvider/defaultModel` — global registry fallback (rarely reached)

Per-project override: write your own `.pi/subagents.json` with a different `defaultModelsByType`; project wins over this global file. Project entry can also be empty `{}` to mean "inherit for all types".

GC-2026-093: the plan-compiler agent's canonical key is now `PlanCompiler` (the previous `Plan` name was misleading — it implied the agent does the planning, but the orchestrator does; the subagent is a brief→plan compiler). `Plan` remains a legacy alias in the registry (existing DAG YAMLs reference `subagent_type: "Plan"`), so users with `"Plan": ...` in their existing subagents.json keep working without edits.

GC-2026-subagent-model-inheritance ships no defaults in `defaultModelsByType` by design — the previous defaults (minimax/MiniMax-M3 for code work, minimax/MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed for search) were removed because they conflicted with the inherit-by-default policy. Users who want those pins back should add them to their own `~/.pi/agent/subagents.json` or project-level `.pi/subagents.json`.
